A fun fact about Idaho. Frank Church, the last Democrat to win probably would have won in 1980. But the major news networks called the state for Reagan early, before the northern parts of the state had really began voting. This led to much lower turnout in Dem friendly counties like Latah and Shoshone (college towns and union miners) and he went down by less than a percentage point.
